Privacy Policy & Cookie Policy

1. INTRODUCTION

Bullion Portfolio Trading LLC (“we”, “us” or “our”) is committed to protecting your privacy and ensuring the security of your personal information.
This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, disclose and protect your information when you visit our website www.bpt-shop.ae and purchase our products (gold & silver).

This policy is subject to the laws of the United Arab Emirates, in particular the UAE Federal Decree-Law No. 45 of 2021 regarding the Protection of Personal Data (PDPL). At the same time, your data benefits from the high security standards of Switzerland thanks to our technology location.

2. WHAT DATA WE COLLECT

We collect information in order to provide our services and comply with the strict legal requirements for precious metals trading.

  • Personal identification data: Name, e-mail address, telephone number, delivery and billing address.
  • KYC & Identity Documents: To comply with UAE Anti-Money Laundering (AML) laws, we collect copies of your passport, Emirates ID and proof of address for transactions above certain thresholds.
  • Financial data: We do not store full credit card details. Payments are processed through secure third party providers. However, we may collect source of funds information as required by law.
  • Technical data & price fixing: IP address, browser type, device information and timestamp. This data is essential in order to document the live market price (spot price) valid at the time of purchase in a tamper-proof manner and to prevent fraud.

3. HOW WE USE YOUR DATA

We use the collected data for the following purposes:

  • Order processing: payment processing, shipping of your order and customer support.
  • Real-time price calculation: Use of technical data to calculate and fix precious metal prices based on live market data (via WooCommerce Precious Metals module).
  • Legal compliance: Know Your Customer (KYC) verification and reporting of suspicious activities to the relevant UAE authorities (e.g. Financial Intelligence Unit) where required by law.
  • Security & infrastructure: Monitoring by our security ecosystem (incl. DDoS protection and backups) to prevent unauthorized access.
  • Communication: Sending order updates and – if you have consented – marketing communication or market alerts.

4. INFRASTRUCTURE & DATA SECURITY

We rely on a high-security architecture (“banking standard”) to protect your data.

  • Data residency: Although our company is based in Dubai, your data is physically hosted in an ISO 27001-certified data center in Zurich, Switzerland. This guarantees physical security and geo-redundancy.
  • Encryption: We implement robust security measures, including SSL/TLS encryption for all data transmissions.
  • Backups: To protect against data loss, we use automated, encrypted backups (via WPvivid Pro), which are stored on external, geo-redundant cloud storage.
  • Access control: Access to KYC documents is strictly limited to authorized compliance personnel.

5. DISCLOSURE OF INFORMATION

We do not sell or rent your personal information. We only share information with:

  • Service provider & technology partner:
    • logistics partners (e.g. Brinks, FedEx, Transguard) for delivery.
    • Payment processor for transactions.
    • IT security service provider (e.g. plus130 AG via availWP) to maintain and ensure system integrity.
  • Legal authorities: We are required by law to disclose information to UAE government authorities (regulators, police, courts) if required for money laundering or fraud investigations.

6. COOKIES AND TRACKING TECHNOLOGIES

Our website uses “cookies” to improve the user experience and to ensure the technical functionality of the store (WooCommerce/Kadence Framework).

  • Essential cookies: Necessary for operation (e.g. keeping items in the shopping cart, secure login, session management).
  • Functional cookies: Save your preferences (e.g. language selection via WPML or currency settings).
  • Analysis cookies: Help us to understand how visitors interact with the site (anonymized).

Administration: You can set your browser to reject cookies. However, this may limit the functionality of the purchase process.

7. SOCIAL MEDIA, TRACKING & MESSENGER

We are present on various platforms and use tracking technologies for marketing purposes.

7.1 WhatsApp Business

If you contact us via WhatsApp, your phone number and chat history will be processed to handle your request.

  • Note: WhatsApp belongs to Meta Platforms, Inc (USA). Although the messages are end-to-end encrypted, metadata can be processed on servers in the USA.

7.2 Social media presence (Instagram, Facebook, LinkedIn, TikTok)

When you visit our profiles on these platforms, the providers (Meta, LinkedIn, TikTok) process your data (e.g. IP address, user behavior) and create usage profiles. We only receive anonymized statistics (“Page Insights”), but have no influence on the data processing by the providers themselves.

7.3 Marketing pixel (retargeting)

If you have given your consent in our cookie banner, we use tracking pixels (Meta Pixel, TikTok Pixel, LinkedIn Insight Tag) on our website.

  • Purpose: This enables us to show you personalized advertising on the respective platforms (retargeting) and to measure the success of our advertising campaigns.
  • Data transmission: Data (e.g. which products you have viewed) is transmitted to the servers of the respective social media providers (often in the USA).

8. DATA STORAGE (RETENTION)

  • General data: We store your data for as long as necessary to fulfill the purposes of this policy.
  • Legal retention period: Due to the UAE AML regulations for precious metals dealers, transaction records and KYC documents must be retained for at least five (5) years after the termination of the business relationship. We cannot delete this specific data upon request before this period expires.

9 INTERNATIONAL DATA TRANSFER

By using our services, you acknowledge and agree that your information will be processed across borders: Our registered office is located in the UAE, while our server infrastructure is located in Switzerland. Both locations offer a high level of data protection.

10. YOUR RIGHTS

Subject to applicable laws, you have the right to information, correction or restriction of your personal data. Please contact us to exercise these rights. Please note that requests for erasure may be rejected if there are statutory retention obligations (see section 7).

11. CONTACT

If you have any questions about this privacy policy, please contact us at Email: complaince@bpt-shop.ae Address: B2B Office Tower, Marasi Drive 12th Floor, Office 1204 | Business Bay | Dubai, UAE
